login route correctly rejects the demo account with the generic 'Invalid email or password' message when hidden (prevents user enumeration).
Admin endpoints properly use constant-check on X-Admin-Key with 403 for wrong/missing key; ADMIN_API_KEY loaded from backend/.env (never exposed to the frontend).
Register/Google routes both call ensure_flags_fresh() so a DB toggle propagates within the 10s TTL without a restart.
Frontend login.tsx conditionally renders 'use-demo-button' and 'toggle-auth-mode' from api.flags(); state defaults are safe (demo hidden, signups allowed) even if the fetch fails.
